parameters.formDescription: Every draft update that waits for a person: the requester, manager and executive updates the forecast trigger drafted, and the close messages from the decide list. Each shows the row every figure comes from. Approve or reject each one. An approved update is placed in the outbox table and nowhere else: nothing is sent to anyone.

parameters.query: select u.update_id, u.audience, u.kind, coalesce(u.to_role, r.requester_role) as to_role, u.request_id, u.subject, u.body, u.draft_problems, u.drafted_by, u.drafted_at::text as drafted_at, u.forecast_run_id, u.facts, u.figures, (select coalesce(json_agg(s), '[]'::json) from changedesk.stale_facts(u.update_id) s) as stale from changedesk.updates u left join changedesk.requests r on r.request_id = u.request_id where u.status = 'draft' order by u.drafted_at, u.update_id;

options.formDescription: Nothing is sent to anyone. An approved update goes to the outbox table. Your name goes on each decision.

parameters.jsCode:
// Done message
return [{ json: { title: "Nothing waits", message: 'No draft waits for approval.' } }];
